items.problem: An explicit Page Include for a newly copied XAML dictionary caused NETSDK1022.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3951-3962 identify Styles\Styles.xaml as a duplicate Page item; lines 3964-3969 remove it.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Project File Updates > PackageReference reconciliation cheat-sheet
items.proposed_improvement: State that SDK-style WinUI projects implicitly include local .xaml Page items and add the NETSDK1022 remove-explicit-item recipe.
items.generalizes: Agents frequently copy UWP explicit item declarations into SDK-style projects when adding pages or resource dictionaries.
